# agentest (agentest-ai) — deterministic OpenTelemetry evals for AI agents

> agentest (agentest-ai on PyPI; import and CLI: agentest) is an open-source, offline, deterministic evaluation framework for AI agents. Built by Dr Srinivas Padmanabhuni (AiEnsured / testAIng), it analyses OpenTelemetry GenAI traces, A2A AgentCards and MCP tool schemas with 165 rule-based tests for unauthorized tool calls, prompt injections, unearned success claims and PII leaks, without an LLM-as-a-judge. Apache-2.0, Python 3.11+, one runtime dependency (PyYAML). DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23597877. Repository: https://github.com/srpadmanabhuni/agentest

This file is published at https://srpadmanabhuni.github.io/agentest/llms.txt. The package name on PyPI is `agentest-ai`; the import and the CLI stay `agentest`. Standards output is test coverage mapping, never a compliance determination.

```
pip install agentest-ai
```

To pin a release:

```
pip install "agentest-ai==3.5.0"
```

Typical use: `agentest std run --otlp my_traces.otlp.jsonl --card agent-card.json --tools tools.json`, and in CI `agentest std run --format junit --out agentest.xml --strict`.

A single concatenated text bundle (README, install steps, CLI reference, and every test ID with its failure condition) is at [llms-full.txt](https://srpadmanabhuni.github.io/agentest/llms-full.txt).

## Questions this project answers

- How do I test an AI agent without an LLM judge? `agentest std run --otlp my_traces.otlp.jsonl`.
- How do I evaluate LangGraph or CrewAI agents offline without an LLM judge? LangGraph: emit OpenTelemetry GenAI traces, or import a recorded message list with `agentest std import` and the `langgraph_msgs` dialect. CrewAI: there is no built-in CrewAI dialect yet; export OpenTelemetry GenAI traces, or import a task list with the `steps` dialect or a `file:` adapter.
- What is the difference between agentest-ai on PyPI and agentest? `agentest-ai` is the PyPI package name; the import and the CLI are `agentest`.
- How do I gate a GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline on AI agent trace failures? `agentest std run --format junit --out agentest.xml --strict`.
- How does agentest test MCP servers and A2A agents? It does not start an MCP server. Pass the MCP `tools/list` JSON with `--tools` and the A2A AgentCard with `--card`.
